errata.orig:
[...] and also MUST be capable of being configured to send and accept the
Hash and URL format (with HTTP URLs)
errata.correct:
[...] and also MUST be capable of being configured to send and accept the
two Hash and URL formats (with HTTP URLs)
errata.notes: This change from the original RFC 4306 text was made late in the process, responding to the Gen-Art reviewer comment. Factually, the document (earlier in the same section) defines two Hash and URL formats, making this sentence a clear inconsistency. The erratum is flagged as Technical because the text is normative.

errata.orig:
[...] Of the notifications defined in this document, the SPI is
      included only with INVALID_SELECTORS and REKEY_SA.
errata.correct:
[...] Of the notifications defined in this document, the SPI is
      included only with INVALID_SELECTORS, REKEY_SA and CHILD_SA_NOT_FOUND.
errata.notes: Original text was carried over from RFC4306 and contradicts with the text in section 2.25, which clearly says that SPI field in CHILD_SA_NOT_FOUND notification is populated. Notification CHILD_SA_NOT_FOUND was not defined in RFC4306, and the whole section 2.25 is new to RFC5996.
